title: Juicy Canadian Apple Pie
description: A tangy and crunchy Canadian dish featuring candied peel and a flaky crust, made with plant-based friendly ingredients, perfect for a nostalgic treat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the cold vegan butter and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the plant-based milk, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out into a circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
In a separate large bowl, combine the sliced apples, candied peel, lemon juice, and cornstarch, and toss until the apples are evenly coated.
Transfer the apple mixture to the center of the dough circle, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the apples, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the crust with a little plant-based milk and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake the pie for 40-50 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the apples are tender.
